description: Robustness of the memory router against untrusted / malformed LLM output: reasoning-leak, CJK-leak, empty/invalid entries, malformed JSON, and null/non-array shapes. Links to 12 §4 (recalled memory is untrusted). Prompt-injection round-trip-inert, delimiter-collision escaping and recall caps (14 §6) are v2-spec requirements absent in v1 and registered as GAP-05.
